Round concrete decimal literals directly to binary32 or binary64. Run the selected JDK formatter bytecode, integer decoder, BigDecimal constructors and comparisons, and BigInteger magnitude operations. Five read-only arithmetic tables come from the fingerprinted Temurin 21 class initializers. Preserve the original UTF-16 units when a String copies a byte range.

Both full-guard fix probes proved their claims and the parent precision probe produced a JVM-replayed counterexample.

The pinned-JDK regression, example 375 validation and test-cost lint passed. Jobs 20261123-134727-qualify-the-four-original-commons-lang-d and 20261123-134736-compare-strict-native-and-jbmc-on-both-o qualify the original tasks and compare both engines.
